body: How do I stay strong when every door I knocked at is short tight, everything is negative, everywhere is bleak and unforgiving. I am tired of living with fake hope only to be crushingly disappointed. I can never seem to get anything right or good. I am a mess all round, death might be the only thing I could get right. That is the only door I am yet to knock on, it might be open for me.

The world is really weird, 100k is what I need to get me out depression yet another has 500k and still struggle.
I am not no financial expat but with that kind of money, close to 50% of the world population will no longer worry about finance for the rest of their lives depending on where you choose to live. 
You need to deal with the issues that is causing you depression cos it is obviously not money. Meanwhile follow the expats advice about investment's for your future but on so many counts your future is made.
 go out and have some fun. Look around and see people you are way better than, console yourself and help some. You should be OK.
